capabilities: Track word counts, writing speed and daily streaks on a yearly calendar
Organize volumes and chapters with automatic renumbering
Copy chapter text with annotations and markers stripped
Keep AI agent annotations in separate files and apply suggestions on approval
Snapshot drafts with visual diff and restore
disambiguation: Not a general-purpose writing suite; it targets long-form Chinese web fiction and novels.
extras: Annotations are stored outside the manuscript in a separate _写作工具箱/批注/ folder; the pomodoro timer is a horizontal pill designed to use minimal vertical space.
problem: Long-form Chinese web novels need chapter renumbering, publisher-ready clean text, daily word-count goals and safe draft history, which Obsidian does not provide on its own.
summary: Suite for drafting long-form Chinese web fiction: word-count dashboard, chapter hierarchy, pomodoro timer, margin annotations and draft snapshots.
